blocks.text:
Day 3: Bogota – Medellin – City Tour: Breakfast at Hotel. Transfer to El Dorado International Airport to take the flight (not included) to the city of Medellin. It is suggested to flight before 10:00 am.

Welcome and assistance at Jose Maria Cordoba Airport and transfer to the Hotel. In the afternoon, let´s spend a great day visiting the main tourist sites of the city: San Antonio Park, San Ignacio Square, the traditional La Playa Avenue, Coltejer Building (one of the symbols of the paisa thriving), Sculpture Park, which contains more than 20 sculptures donated by Master Fernando Botero to the city of Medellín, the big houses and mansions of the traditional Prado neighborhood, Parque de Los Deseos, Atanasio Girardot Sports Unit where most of the sports practiced in the city take place, in 

addition to the remodeled Macarena Convention Center, the old bullring. Finally, we visit the traditional Pueblito Paisa and end with a tour by the Poblado area, where we will visit Parque del Poblado, Lleras Park and the Golden Mile, the financial and hotel heart of the city.

Duration: 4 Hours 

Includes: Transport in tourist vehicle, bilingual guide. Stops at the Barefoot Park, Sculpture Park, Wish Park, and Pueblito Paisa, Metro and Metro Cable Entrance.
